bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT\n'
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DIRTY_TRACKED='; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l
printf 'FETCH_REMOTES\n'; git remote -v | sed -E 's#(https?://)[^/@]+:[^/@]+@#\1[REDACTED]@#g' | head -2
printf 'COMPOSE_LABELS\n'; docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}} {{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'COMPOSE_FILES\n'; ls -l deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml deploy/Dockerfile 2>&1
printf 'RUNTIME_ENV_KEYS\n'; docker inspect --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 | cut -d= -f1 | sort | grep -E '^VIDEOBOT_|^CREATEVDOBOT_|^GSERVER_' || true
printf 'RUNTIME_VOLUMES\n'; docker inspect --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination}}{{end}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 | sort
printf 'DOCKER_IMAGE\n'; docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'HOST_DISK\n'; df -h . | tail -1
